text:
inc_bot: 🚨 ALERT: gpu_pool_exhaustion in asia-east1. Autoscaler failed to allocate new GPUs (quota DENIED). Paging ops_pager. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota>

ops_pager: paging irene_sre (oncall) + infra team — please ack

irene_sre: ack, I'm on it. Joining bridge shortly. Who has recent quotas for asia-east1?

leo_infra: I see repeated GCP errors in the allocator logs:
```
Error: RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Requested GPUs (16) exceed project quota (100 -> used 100)
RequestId: 0xabc12345
Allocator: autoscaler-asia-east1-v2
```
Also observed pool attach denials at 08:14:22 UTC.

sam_prod: customer impact: hosted inference 95p latency up ~3.2x for apac traffic, error rate 5xx ~6% in last 5m. Top affected customers: acme-inc (prod), vectra.ai (staging). Some requests are queued for >30s and then 502.

hana_support: 3 new tickets opened, CS has initial templates ready. pinged acme contact (they're seeing timeout spikes). Suggest statuspage update if we can't mitigate in 15m.

mike_eng: mitigation options (quick):
- reroute ~40% of apac read-only traffic to us-west2 (weights) via smart routing
- throttle non-urgent background/batch inference jobs in apac
- enable quantized smaller model variant for low-priority routes
- temporary fairshare tweak: deprioritize sandbox/dev customers
- submit quota increase to GCP (already created a support case, case# 7654321)

carol_customer_ops: I'll draft a short status note for affected customers. If we can drop error rate <1% within 20m we can avoid broad outage message.

irene_sre: executing routing change now. Reducing asia-east1 route weight to 0.6 -> 0.25 for public-hosted. Applying via console.

ops_pager: routing change applied at 08:22:10 UTC. Observability: stream of apac requests dropping ~38% to asia-east1.

leo_infra: paused non-critical batch queues and scaled down training tenants on the apac clusters (freed ~12 GPUs). Allocator still getting some DENY responses but queue length stopped growing.

sam_prod: metrics: 95p latency down from 3.2x to 1.5x within 5m of reroute. 5xx reduced to 2.1%. Good trend but still above baseline.

mike_eng: started model fallback rollout for low-priority routes — switching to q4_0 model for 20% of apac traffic.

hana_support: notified the 3 affected customers with current mitigation steps and ETA for next update in 30m.

tickets_bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-5987 and linked to support case #7654321.

irene_sre: next steps: 1) monitor for 15m, 2) follow up on quota increase, 3) consider routing heavier customers to reserved dedicated pools if we hit limits again. I'll stay on the thread until stable.

mike_eng: filing post-incident action items: request cross-region warm pools, refine autoscaler backoff retries, and add quota preflight checks to deploy pipeline.

inc_bot: incident annotated. Please add any notes to the runbook and tag for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
